prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Previous Pet Restore Reassurance Hint: Adds an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets and saved items are automatically restored upon signing in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in automatically restores your existing pets, custom progress, and saved items."}}
1: [home, wait_info] Generation Safety Countdown and Restore Indicator: Displays live progress and cloud backup status alongside the generation countdown on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "hint": "Your pet is being generated and saved securely to your account cloud."}}
2: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selection Personality Card Redesign: Redesigns the path selection screen with structured cards focusing on companion personality traits and journey duration.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "card", "replace": {"path_options": [{"role": "path_options", "type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select your companion personality and journey speed"}]}}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Placement Launch Verification Screen: Adds a dedicated confirmation screen right before completing onboarding to verify desktop readiness and launch status.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_launch_verify"], "new_launch_verify": {"headline": "Pet Ready for Your Desktop", "body": "Your pet is active on your desktop screen.", "button_label": "Start Playing"}}
4: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-In Account Sync Card Redesign: Redesigns the sign-in interface into clean option cards highlighting quick sign-in and cloud pet recovery.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "card", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"role": "sign_in_options", "type": "choice_cards", "text": "Sign in to backup your pet and restore existing companions"}]}}}
5: [choose_path, hint] Starter Companion Fast-Track Hint: Adds a hint on the path choice screen highlighting expected setup completion time under 1 minute.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Fast-track companion setup takes under 1 minute and automatically backs up your progress."}}
6: [adoption, copy] Customization Safety and Format Guidance Copy: Updates headline and body copy on the photo upload screen to provide clear photo quality guidelines for pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Pet Photo for Custom Companion", "body": "Use clear, well-lit photos for the best companion rendering results."}}
7: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Adoption Companion Selection Flow: Introduces a grid layout flow for selecting instant pet presets to prevent generation issues and speed up customization.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "hint": "Choose from instant starter pets or build a custom companion."}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Alert Notification: Enables desktop readiness alert notifications when pet generation completes on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will alert you on your desktop as soon as your companion is ready."}}
9: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Visibility Control Hint: Adds a persistent guidance hint on the home intro screen detailing tray icon controls to show, hide, or talk to the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Click the desktop tray icon anytime to hide, show, or control your companion."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a valid reassurance hint on the sign-in screen without violating any rules.
Displays progress and time estimates on the waiting screen during actual generation, which is permitted.
Replaces path options with personality selection, losing the required job of offering both adopting and making your own pet.
Adds a new verification screen after home_intro while retaining all required onboarding steps.
Redesigns sign-in options while preserving the core sign-in functionality.
Adds setup guidance text on the path choice screen without removing steps or jobs.
Updates photo upload guidance copy appropriately within onboarding.
Updates the pet selection screen layout while maintaining its core selection job.
Enables desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen within onboarding limits.
Adds helpful control guidance text to the home intro screen.
